text: Offshore intake head above the pycnocline at about -12 m (at least 3 m above seabed, about 650 m offshore) with velocity cap and intake velocity <= 0.15 m/s; intake pipelines; pump house; outfall diffuser at least 250 m from the intake discharging into the upper layer (ALP-OWN-MAR-001 section 6).
title: Once-through seawater cooling
